purpose: Fresh supervised experiments on the frozen grouped weak-label dataset; not independent operational validation

behavior.selection: maximum validation stage macro-F1 plus action micro-F1
behavior.precision_note: Both full-trial representations use the same CUDA AMP setting; the earlier feasibility pilots used float32.

promotion_policy: No automatic replacement of active checkpoints; report failures and weak-label scope
independent_review: User confirmed prepared queues should be used; reviews are pending
test_policy: Evaluate once after validation checkpoint selection. These inspected results become development evidence if used for subsequent model choices.
